use_case_summary: Goal: replace heuristic search with dense embeddings for product & docs search. Primary flows: 1) realtime query-to-vector -> top-K similarity (target 100 QPS peak, 50 QPS sustained), 2) nightly bulk embedding job for ~10M documents, 3) rerank pipeline combining signals. Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, wants clear per-token and per-embedding unit economics. Needs low tail latency for UI-facing queries (<120ms p95).
requirements_summary: Throughput: 100 QPS peak for vector queries; write throughput for nightly ingest ~10M vectors within 4-hour ETL window. Integration: must integrate with Milvus (preferred) and support fast export/import, snapshot/restore. Batch jobs: efficient bulk-embedding API or S3-to-embeds connector. Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, per-model rollout metrics. Security: SSO/SAML, KMS for key mgmt, audit logs for data residency and retention policies. Rollout: start on Hosted for speed, evaluate migration path to Dedicated (reserved GPUs) with matching model variants and fallback routing.
poc_plan: Week 1: ingest 1M sample docs, validate embedding quality vs current baseline, measure avg token cost
Week 2: scale ingest to 10M (staged), run nightly embed job, measure ETL window and egress costs
Metrics to collect: p95 query latency, QPS sustainable, per-embed cost, index build time, cold-cache cold-start token counts
Success criteria: parity-or-better relevance on evaluation set, <120ms p95 for 50 QPS, nightly ingest completes within 4 hours, predictable cost model
commercial_notes: Initial ARR estimate 50k-150k. Interested in 12-month committed Dedicated pricing after POC if Hosted demonstrates performance and cost savings. Asked about burst capacity and automatic fallback to smaller model variants. Wants an itemized pricing deck + example cost projections for 1M, 5M, 10M doc scenarios.
technical_blockers: Vector DB connector maturity (Milvus export/import), network egress costs for nightly jobs, VPC peering setup for Dedicated/VPC control plane, data residency confirmation for EU customers.
